name: Summer Camp
description:
About This Game

SUMMER CAMP is a narrative party game where you and up to 3 friends create the ultimate summer adventure! Explore the camp by uncovering hidden narratives, unique characters, and secrets across 5 thematic areas. Meet quirky counselors and campers while conquering action-packed mini-games that let winners choreograph the storyline. Mini-game victories write the camp's story, so compete to steer everyone's summer in wild directions and become camp legend!

  • 4-player Local Co-Op

  • Action-packed mini-games with multiple variations

  • Branching narratives controlled by mini-game winners

  • 5 thematic camp areas filled with secrets and surprises

  • Quirky counselors and campers with unique personalities

  • Multi-day camp sessions with evolving storylines

  • Hidden narrative paths and camp mysteries to uncover

  • Replayable adventures with different story combinations

Play the Summer Camp Demo!

Our early demo lets you and up to 3 friends experience a taste of camp life together. You'll get one mini-game, one compressed day at camp, and one story cycle. This is just a glimpse of what's coming in the full release. Jump in, have fun, and don't forget to wishlist us if you're feeling the camp vibes.

We'd love to hear what you think! Your feedback helps us build the camp experience we're working toward.
short_desc: Summer Camp is a narrative party game where you and friends make choices that shape your perfect summer camp experience. Play action-packed mini-games, interact with quirky counselors and campers, and see how your decisions create unique stories across multiple days at camp.
